qa.title: Q1456 (Aug. 8, 2025)
qa.question: When attacking using a follower with Twin Drive, if I reveal a Trigger with the first drive check, do I resolve the Trigger before or after performing the second drive check?
qa.answer: You resolve the Trigger first. For example, if you reveal and resolve a Draw Trigger with the first drive check, you will draw a card, put the resolved Trigger into your cemetery, then perform the second drive check. If you choose not to resolve the Trigger, you will put it on the bottom of your deck, then perform the second drive check.

(2) Select a follower in your cemetery and add it to your hand. (3) Give your leader {icon_hp|[defense]}+4.

qa.title: Q1455 (Aug. 8, 2025)
qa.question: When choosing multiple options, can I choose the same option multiple times?
qa.answer: No, you can't.

qa.title: Q1454 (Aug. 8, 2025)
qa.question: If I have followers on the field with Drive, do the Drive Points linked to them count as faceup cards named Drive Points in my evolve deck?
qa.answer: No. Drive Points linked to followers on the field are not faceup cards in your evolve deck.
